description: This file defines the Task model for the Global Task Framework (GTF) in the Superset project. It manages asynchronous task tracking, including properties, status, timestamps, payloads, and subscriber relationships, with methods for updating state, handling errors, and serialization.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous task within the Superset Global Task Framework, including properties, status, timestamps, payload, and subscriber management.

methods.name: properties_dict
methods.description: Returns the task's properties as a typed dictionary, parsed from JSON.

methods.name: update_properties
methods.description: Merges and updates specific properties fields in the task.

methods.name: payload_dict
methods.description: Returns the task's payload as a parsed JSON dictionary.

methods.name: set_payload
methods.description: Merges new data into the task's payload JSON.

methods.name: set_error_from_exception
methods.description: Sets error-related properties based on an exception.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Updates the task's status, timestamps, and deduplication key.

methods.name: is_pending
methods.description: Checks if the task is pending.

methods.name: is_running
methods.description: Checks if the task is currently running.

methods.name: is_finished
methods.description: Checks if the task has finished (success, failure, aborted, or timed out).

methods.name: is_successful
methods.description: Checks if the task completed successfully.

methods.name: duration_seconds
methods.description: Calculates the duration of the task in seconds based on timestamps.

methods.name: is_private
methods.description: Checks if the task scope is private.

methods.name: is_shared
methods.description: Checks if the task scope is shared.

methods.name: is_system
methods.description: Checks if the task scope is system.

methods.name: subscriber_count
methods.description: Returns the number of subscribers to the task.

methods.name: has_subscriber
methods.description: Checks if a specific user is subscribed to the task.

methods.name: get_subscriber_ids
methods.description: Returns a list of user IDs subscribed to the task.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Serializes the task to a dictionary for API responses.
